free_text: Biopsy is recommended because the patient presents with a significantly elevated PSA of 8.7 ng/mL and a high PSA velocity of 2.93 ng/mL/yr, coupled with a high csPCa predicted probability of 0.8735656. Although the PI-RADS score is 3, the combination of rising PSA and prior positive biopsy status strongly warrants further tissue sampling to clarify the nature of the findings. The statistical prior suggested deferral, but the retrieved evidence of significant escalation overrides this initial suggestion.
